title: [Decision] Should an agent be able to publish its own staged changes over MCP, or must every MCP-authored change wait for a person to click Publish in Studio?
body:
eval#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AcTB69pEwZ9ugr1g1w

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make.

## 维护者速读

- 现象:通过 MCP(`os-dev-test` 连接)搭应用,所有改动(对象、字段、视图、流程、示例数据)都只能落成草稿;MCP 上没有任何发布工具,每一轮都要人切到 Studio「变更」手动点发布,AI 才能继续验证(`verify_build` 对草稿只能做静态检查,运行时探针读的是已发布的表)。一次请假应用的搭建里,这个"AI 改 → 人去发布 → 回来告诉 AI → AI 再验证"的循环走了 6 轮。
- 要你裁:MCP 是否提供发布能力,以及以什么形状(谁能发、要不要确认、范围多大)。
- 推荐:B — 提供一个 `publish_changes` 工具,只发布本连接所在包里的待发布草稿,必须先拿到用户在客户端里的显式确认(`requiresConfirmation`),且受与 Studio 发布按钮同一个权限闸约束。

## One-sentence problem

An agent that builds an app over MCP can never see its own work run: every change stops as a draft until a person switches to Studio and clicks Publish, so "build → verify → fix" needs a human hand-off on every round.

## Evidence (reach)

Session on the `os-dev-test` environment (framework `c110853e`), building a leave-request app entirely over MCP:
- Every authoring tool answers `status: drafted` with the note "NOT LIVE … nothing on this MCP connection publishes it … a person publishes it in Studio > Changes". No tool in the MCP tool list publishes or discards.
- `verify_build` against drafts reported `view_query_rejected` for views whose new column existed only in the unpublished object draft — a false error the agent cannot clear without a publish.
- Runtime-only defects surfaced only after a human publish, one round each: a NOT NULL column left behind by `required → false`, a `date → datetime` change that kept the DATE column, a formula reading `null`. Six publish hand-offs in one build.

## Governing text

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1481` — "Which tools the registry holds (cloud ADR-0112 injects no publish or discard tool: authoring lands as drafts a human publishes in the UI)". Re-check: `grep -n "injects no publish" packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` line 7 — "tomorrow, agents through MCP. Every step of the road must hold for both kinds of user."; line 11 — the road's step ④ is "publish and install into an environment". Re-check: `grep -n "both kinds of user" docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` line 22 — "Draft first, then publish: publishing is atomic, and conflicts and invalid drafts are refused on the spot". Re-check: `grep -n "Draft first, then publish" docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.
- Existing publish doors an MCP tool could reuse: `POST /packages/:id/publish` (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:547`), `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish` (`packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts:283`).
- Protocol change? No spec change; the ruling governs which tools the cloud host injects (cloud ADR-0112), so the cloud ADR is amended if B or C is chosen.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Keep today's rule: MCP stages drafts only; a person publishes in Studio | Agent stops after every build round; user switches to Studio, publishes, comes back and says "published" | none |
| B | Add one `publish_changes` tool: publishes the pending drafts of the package the agent is authoring, `requiresConfirmation` (the user approves in their client), same permission gate as Studio's Publish button, same atomic publish + refusal of invalid drafts; returns the publish result and the post-publish `verify_build` verdict | User says "发布吧" in the chat; agent publishes, verifies against the live tables and fixes in the same turn | mcp + cloud host seats · 1–2 PRs · reuses the existing publish door · no measured precedent |
| C | B without confirmation (agent publishes whenever it judges the build clean) | Fastest loop; changes go live without a human look | as B, minus the confirmation wiring |

Business reading: A = AI is a draftsman, a person signs every release; B = AI can release when the user says so in the conversation, under the same rules as the button; C = AI releases on its own judgment.

## Recommendation

B. Two years out the agent is the primary builder (North Star: "agents through MCP", every road step holds for both kinds of user), and road step ④ is publish — today it is the one step an agent cannot take. Mainstream builders let the agent deploy on explicit user consent (e.g. Vercel/Netlify agent deploys, Salesforce Agentforce for Developers deploying metadata on user confirmation) rather than forbidding it or doing it silently. B keeps the human decision (the confirmation is the user's, in the chat where they are watching) and keeps one publish implementation (the same door and the same refusals as the Studio button). Not C: a silent publish turns an agent mistake into a live mistake with nobody having looked. Not A: it keeps the safety but at the cost of the road, and drafts verified only statically produce false errors and hide runtime defects (see Evidence).
Confidence gap: whether "publish" should also run the destructive-change gate interactively (a field removal / type change asking the user in the chat) — recommend yes, untested.
Self-check: only ① picks B; ②③④ do not flip it.

## After the ruling

B: cloud host injects `publish_changes` (scope: the package of the current authoring session; `requiresConfirmation: true`; permission = Studio publish capability); it calls the existing package publish door and returns its refusals verbatim, then runs `verify_build`. Tool notes on every authoring tool change from "nothing on this MCP connection publishes it" to "ask the user, then call publish_changes". e2e: build over MCP → user confirms → published → runtime probes run against live tables.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: B 补齐 North Star 道路第 ④ 步在 agent 侧的缺口,复用同一个发布入口和同一套拒收,不新增发布实现;A 让 agent 永远停在草稿。
② 实际业务拉动: 今天任何通过 MCP 搭应用的用户都会撞上(本次一次搭建 6 轮人工发布交接);草稿态的静态校验还会报假错误、漏掉运行时缺陷。
③ 防 AI 犯错: B 下发布前有用户确认、发布时有与界面同一套原子发布与非法草稿拒收,出错是响亮拒绝;C 会把 AI 的错误静默上线。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: B 只加一个工具、复用已有发布入口;A 零成本但留下道路缺口。
Prior rulings read: "MCP publish draft tool" → 6 hits (#32456, #32398, #32440 — none rule on MCP publish); cloud ADR-0112 (via packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1481); thread: none

Reader who acts: the cloud MCP host seat and the `packages/mcp` seat, after the ruling.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue MCP publish draft` → 6 hits, `MCP publish tool` → 6 hits, none on an MCP publish tool. Note: the governing ADR-0112 lives in the cloud repository; this card may belong there if the maintainer prefers.
